final: SELECT c.zoneref AS zoneref, s.insurstat AS insurstat, COUNT(*) AS n, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scanconservation c2 JOIN sites s2 ON s2.zoneregistry = c2.zoneref) AS fraction FROM scanconservation c JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = c.zoneref GROUP BY c.zoneref, s.insurstat ORDER BY fraction DESC LIMIT 10
